entities.title: utv package
entities.summary: The Python package utv: the typed layer of library 0.3 on top of the JSON layer of 0.1 and 0.2.
entities.purpose: Holds every module of the package. The typed layer (values.py, outcome.py, policy.py, context.py, interop.py) gives one immutable type per everyday value and Outcome[T] for partial answers. Underneath it, the JSON layer works on plain UTV JSON dicts and returns Result envelopes: builders (build.py), ISO 8601 and the text form (iso.py, text.py), the everyday operations (ops.py), zone rules and resolution (zones.py), native datetime adapters (native.py) and their shared checks (_core.py). validate.py and gregorian.py are the 0.1 structural and Gregorian checks, and result.py the utv-result/1.0 envelope. __init__.py re-exports all of it.
boundaries: Imports only the standard library. datetime and zoneinfo appear only in native.py and interop.py.
Reads no file on its own apart from the bundled schema in data/. A zone-rule file is read only when the caller names it (ZoneRules.load).
Never reads the clock, the host time zone, the locale or the network; tests/test_everyday_api.py (Purity) checks the source for it.
The contracts it implements belong to docs/ and spec/; this folder's own promise is the Result envelope in contracts.json.
